fields.statement: At 7e0959aa, with RHIZA_* unset and GOTMPDIR/TMPDIR outside the repo, ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-continue-slot|describe-golden|daemon-status.*|daemon-root.*)$': all PASS. daemon-continue-slot.txtar (fake rex) has one live running run, max-runs 1, and two interrupted runs queued with rhiza run resume. rhiza daemon status prints QUEUEDONE01 and QUEUEDTWO02 as 'interrupted, queued, waiting for a slot (place 1)/(place 2)', and --json gives queued 1 and 2 with state interrupted. An interrupted run with nothing queued (PLAININT003) shows plain 'interrupted' with no queued field. describe-golden passes with the new queued field (omitempty int) on both DaemonRun schemas. Read the diff: daemonStatusRuns numbers places over the project's continuation queue in order, counting only entries daemonContinueCanStart accepts (the same predicate the slot accounting uses), for both per-project and root-home status. go test ./internal/api -run Daemon: every test PASS. The package's root-state guard then flagged ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon writes; this change does not.
